notes.title: FERB Beta 2
notes.notes:
The second beta for FERB has been released. It is a major update as we get closer to the release which is set to release late 2024. There are plenty of new features.

[h2]New Lighting[/h2]
It is now nighttime! The cave is creepier than ever. The cave is almost impossible to explore without your [b]flashlight[/b]

The flashlight is a new item that you get at the start of the game and is very helpful when in the cave.

[h2]New AI[/h2]
Ferb’s AI has been majorly improved! He can now hear footsteps and other noises such as dropping an item. You need to crouch if you want to sneak past him.

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]
The player now has a model! So you can see your friends when playing multiplayer.
The ground now has grass so it looks a lot better.
The mountain is now growing moss.
New gameplay!
Lots more!

notes.title: FERB Early Access
notes.notes:
FERB Early Access is now available! Venture into the cave in this new version like never before!
This is the first build of FERB to be available on steam. It is closer to the final release, which we hope to release later this year / early next year. Purchase the Early Access now and play now!
